check_prop: SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.farSmall : ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → Prop

prints.pairEps:
def SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.pairEps : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ :=
fun ε δ γ₀ =>
  SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.pairConst -
    (2 * (1 - (2 * ε + ε ^ 2)) - δ ^ 2 / (2 * γ₀ ^ 2) * (1 + (2 * ε + ε ^ 2))) / (1 + ε) ^ 2
prints.farSmall:
def SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.farSmall : ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → Prop :=
fun γ₀ φ δ ε => ‖SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.farFT γ₀ φ δ‖ ≤ ε * SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.nearInt φ δ
prints.nearInt:
def SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.nearInt : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ :=
fun φ δ => ∫ (u : ℝ), φ u * Real.cosh (δ * u)
prints.farFT:
def SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.farFT : ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℂ :=
fun γ₀ φ δ => Zeta23.paperFT (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.phiC φ) (2 * ↑γ₀ - Complex.I * ↑δ)
prints.nearPair:
def SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.nearPair : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ :=
fun γ₀ δ N => ((↑δ ^ 2 + 2 * Complex.I * ↑γ₀ * ↑δ) * ↑N / 2) ^ 2 + ((↑δ ^ 2 - 2 * Complex.I * ↑γ₀ * ↑δ) * ↑N / 2) ^ 2
prints.pairTwo:
def SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.pairTwo : ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℂ :=
fun γ₀ φ δ =>
  Zeta23.paperFT (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.kWin γ₀ φ) (Zeta23.gammaOf (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.rhoZero γ₀ δ)) +
    Zeta23.paperFT (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.kWin γ₀ φ)
      (Zeta23.gammaOf (Zeta23.reflect (SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.rhoZero γ₀ δ)))
prints.rhoZero:
def SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.rhoZero : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ :=
fun γ₀ δ => 1 / 2 + ↑δ + ↑γ₀ * Complex.I
